create_encoder_subclass: create a subclass of FairseqEncoder that implements forward and reorder_encoder_out methods
review_encoderout_namedtuple: review the EncoderOut NamedTuple fields including encoder_out, encoder_padding_mask, and encoder_states
implement_forward_method: implement the forward method in a FairseqEncoder subclass to process src_tokens and src_lengths
